newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal buys diesel from Mabanaft, to award SKO soon.
newsitem.headline: Nepal buys diesel from Mabanaft, to award SKO soon.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has awarded a tender to buy 30,000-tonnes of high speed diesel for March delivery to MidEast trader Mabanaft and is expected to award two kerosene cargoes to Dutch trader Vitol later on Tuesday, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender to buy diesel was awarded at $202.75 per tonne cost-and-freight (c-and-f) to the Indian east coast for arrival on March 11-20.

Sources said NOC will award the kerosene tender later today as all terms of the tender have not been finalised but Vitol is expected to be awarded both cargoes at $235-$240 per tonne c-and-f east coast for March 1-10 and 21-31 deliveries.
The tender closes on February 5 and offers are valid to February 7.
NOC last bought diesel and kerosene for February arrival at $239.39 per tonne and $274 per tonne, respectively, on a c-and-f east coast basis.
